theme.id: What if you live with fearless?
theme.en: What if you live with fearless?

intro.id: Perjalanan interaktif untuk menemukan hal yang bikin kamu excited, mengatasi keraguan, dan menjelajahi kemungkinan dirimu.
intro.en: An interactive journey to discover what excites you, overcome your doubts, and explore what you could become.

lead.id:
What if you live with fearless in a day?
Are you ready to explore?
lead.en:
What if you live with fearless in a day?
Are you ready to explore?

namePrompt.en: But first, what should we call you?

tip.id: Tip: pilih yang paling kamu banget. Nggak ada jawaban yang salah, tiap pilihan bikin ceritamu beda.
tip.en: Tip: pick what feels most like you. There are no wrong answers, and every choice shapes your story.

based.id: Berdasarkan rasa penasaranmu, di sini petualanganmu bisa dimulai:
based.en: Based on your curiosity, here is where your adventure could begin:

free.id: Ini cuma titik awal. Semua booth boleh kamu jelajahi!
free.en: These are just your starting points. Every booth is yours to explore!

shareText.en: I am {type} in the Emina 20 Under 20 Explorer Quiz. Which Explorer are you?

stagesSub.en: 3 talkshow sessions to spark new insights for your journey

desc.id: Kamu suka mengeksplorasi musik, cerita, dan karya yang bisa menghubungkan banyak orang.
desc.en: You love exploring music, stories, and creative works that connect people.

tag.id: Selalu ada cerita di balik yang kamu suka.
tag.en: Every song, story, and scene means something.

energy.id: Yang selalu punya lagu, film, atau cerita buat direkomendasiin.
energy.en: The one who always has a song, movie, or story to recommend

nutshell.en: You love discovering the stories behind music, movies, and creative works that bring people together

desc.id: Kamu suka mengubah ide-ide random jadi sesuatu yang seru dan punya ciri khas kamu sendiri.

tag.en: Your mind is always making something.

nutshell.en: You love turning random ideas into something exciting and uniquely yours

desc.id: Kamu suka tantangan baru dan nggak ragu buat nyobain hal yang belum pernah kamu lakukan.
desc.en: You love jumping into new challenges and trying things you've never done before.

tag.en: Less thinking about it, more trying it.

energy.id: Yang bilang “cobain yuk!” sebelum yang lain selesai mikir.
energy.en: The one who says “Let's try!” before anyone else has decided

nutshell.id: Kamu suka nyemplung ke pengalaman baru, ambil tantangan, dan lihat ke mana arahnya.
nutshell.en: You love jumping into new experiences, taking on challenges, and seeing where they lead.

desc.id: Kamu selalu penasaran sama cara sesuatu bekerja dan suka menemukan hal-hal baru.
desc.en: You're always curious about how things work and love discovering something new.

tag.en: One question leads to a hundred more.

energy.id: Yang ujung-ujungnya riset satu pertanyaan random berjam-jam.
energy.en: The one who somehow ends up researching a random question for hours

nutshell.en: You love figuring out how things work and discovering things you never knew existed

desc.id: Kamu peduli sama hal-hal kecil dan suka mencari cara untuk membawa perubahan.

energy.id: Yang sadar siapa yang ketinggalan, terus mastiin dia ikut.
energy.en: The one who notices who's being left out and makes sure they're included

nutshell.id: Kamu peduli sama hal kecil dan suka cari cara buat bikin perubahan nyata.
nutshell.en: You care about the little things and love finding ways to make a real difference

desc.id: Kamu suka mengekspresikan diri lewat gaya, warna, dan detail kecil yang bikin semuanya lebih kamu.
desc.en: You love expressing yourself through your own style, colors, and little details.

tag.en: Your style speaks before you do.

energy.id: Yang bisa bikin outfit paling simpel jadi satu look utuh.
energy.en: The one who can turn the simplest outfit into a whole look

nutshell.id: Buat kamu, gaya itu cara nunjukin siapa kamu, sampai ke detail terkecil.
nutshell.en: You see style as a way to express who you are, right down to the smallest details

Explore and express your beauty & style

Tinker with tech, code, and experiments

tag.id: Mulai hal baik buat orang dan bumi
tag.en: Start something good for people and the planet

SKILL.id: Kamu nggak harus jago buat mulai. Mulai itu yang bikin kamu jago.
SKILL.en: You do not have to be good to begin. Beginning is how you get good.

EXPECTATION.id: Nggak semua harus jadi sempurna. Yang penting jadi.
EXPECTATION.en: Not everything has to turn out perfectly. It just has to turn out.

FAILURE.id: Kesalahan sering jadi jalan ke hal yang nggak kamu duga.
FAILURE.en: Mistakes can lead to something unexpected.

IMPACT.id: Langkah sekecil apa pun tetep bikin beda. Buat kamu dulu, baru buat orang lain.
IMPACT.en: Even small steps can make a difference. For you first, then for others.

beats.id: Kamu bangun dan nemu sebuah undangan misterius di meja: “Hari ini kamu boleh explore apa pun yang bikin kamu penasaran. Yuk, mulai.”
beats.en: You wake up to find a mysterious invitation: “Today, you can explore anything you have ever been curious about. Let’s go.”

prompt.id: Kalau bisa nyoba satu hal baru hari ini, kamu paling excited buat...
prompt.en: If you could try one new thing today, what would excite you most?

label.id: Tampil dan mengekspresikan diri di depan orang banyak
label.en: Performing and expressing yourself in front of a crowd

react.id: Kamu langsung kebayang lampu panggung. Deg-degan, tapi senyum kamu nggak bisa ditahan.
react.en: You picture the stage lights right away. Nervous, but you cannot stop smiling.

label.id: Bikin sesuatu yang belum pernah kamu buat
label.en: Creating something you have never made before

react.id: Tangan kamu udah gatel pengin mulai. Entah apa bentuknya nanti, yang penting punya kamu.
react.en: Your hands are itching to start. Whatever it turns into, it will be yours.

label.id: Mencoba challenge yang bikin adrenaline naik
label.en: Trying an adrenaline-pumping challenge

react.id: Jantung kamu udah lari duluan. Hari ini kayaknya bakal seru.
react.en: Your heart is already racing ahead of you. Today is going to be fun.

label.id: Menemukan sesuatu yang bisa membawa perubahan
label.en: Discovering something that could make a difference

react.id: Kamu kepikiran satu hal kecil yang bisa kamu ubah hari ini. Dari situ aja dulu.
react.en: You think of one small thing you could change today. Start there.

beats.id: Kamu keluar dan nemu jalanan penuh tempat menarik. Semua pintunya kebuka, tapi satu langsung bikin kamu berhenti.
beats.en: You step outside onto a street full of exciting places. Every door is open, but one instantly catches your attention.

prompt.id: Kamu bakal langsung masuk ke tempat yang...
prompt.en: Which place would you walk into first?

label.id: Ada orang lagi jamming dan sing-along bareng
label.en: People are jamming and singing along together

react.id: Baru masuk, kamu udah ikut nyanyi bagian reff. Nggak ada yang nanya kamu siapa.
react.en: You are singing the chorus before you even sit down. Nobody asks who you are.

label.id: Penuh karya seni dan orang lagi DIY
label.en: Artworks and people making DIY creations fill the space

react.id: Ada meja kosong dan sekotak bahan. Kamu duduk tanpa mikir dua kali.
react.en: There is an empty table and a box of materials. You sit down without a second thought.

label.id: Ada orang lagi main games dan mini challenges
label.en: People are playing games and trying mini challenges

react.id: Kamu kalah di ronde pertama, terus langsung minta main lagi.
react.en: You lose the first round and immediately ask for another.

label.id: Ada teknologi interaktif yang belum pernah kamu coba
label.en: There is interactive technology you have never tried

react.id: Kamu pencet semua tombolnya dulu, baru baca petunjuknya.
react.en: You press every button first, then read the instructions.

beats.id: Tiba-tiba muncul challenge. Kamu punya waktu buat bikin sesuatu, dengan cara kamu sendiri.
beats.en: Suddenly, a challenge appears. You have time to create something entirely your own way.

prompt.id: Kalau dikasih kebebasan buat bikin sesuatu, kamu pilih...
prompt.en: If you had total freedom to create something, what would you choose?

label.id: Mendesain packaging produk beauty versiku sendiri
label.en: Create my own beauty product packaging

react.id: Warna pertama yang kamu pilih langsung kerasa kamu banget.
react.en: The first colour you pick already feels like you.

label.id: Mengubah ide-ideku jadi sebuah film pendek
label.en: Turn my ideas into a short movie

react.id: Adegan pertamanya udah ada di kepala kamu dari tadi.
react.en: The first scene has been playing in your head all along.

label.id: Customize aksesori yang bener-bener mencerminkan diriku
label.en: Customize an accessory that screams ME!

react.id: Kamu nggak mau yang rapi. Kamu mau yang keliatan punya kamu.
react.en: You do not want it neat. You want it to look like yours.

label.id: Membuat sesuatu yang membantu orang lain atau lingkungan
label.en: Create something that helps people or the planet

react.id: Kamu mulai dari masalah yang kamu liat tiap hari. Kecil, tapi nyata.
react.en: You start from a problem you see every day. Small, but real.

beats.id: Pas mau mulai, tiba-tiba ada satu pikiran yang bikin kamu ragu.
beats.en: Just as you are about to start, one doubtful thought creeps in.

prompt.id: Apa yang paling bikin kamu ragu buat nyoba sesuatu yang baru?
prompt.en: What makes you hesitate most when trying something new?

label.id: Takut nggak cukup jago buat mulai.
label.en: What if I am not good enough to start?

react.id: Kamu nggak harus jago buat mulai. Mulai itu yang bikin kamu jago.
react.en: You do not have to be good to begin. Beginning is how you get good.

label.id: Takut hasilnya nggak sesuai ekspektasi.
label.en: What if it does not turn out as I expected?

react.id: Nggak semua harus jadi sempurna. Yang penting jadi.
react.en: Not everything has to turn out perfectly. It just has to turn out.

label.id: Takut gagal atau bikin kesalahan.
label.en: What if I fail or make mistakes?

react.id: Kesalahan sering jadi jalan ke hal yang nggak kamu duga.
react.en: Mistakes can lead to something unexpected.

label.id: Takut apa yang aku lakuin nggak berarti apa-apa.
label.en: What if what I do does not matter?

react.id: Langkah sekecil apa pun tetep bikin beda. Buat kamu dulu, baru buat orang lain.
react.en: Even small steps can make a difference. For you first, then for others.

beats.id: Kamu denger seseorang cerita dari panggung. Ternyata mereka juga pernah takut, sebelum akhirnya berani nyoba.
beats.en: You hear someone share their story on stage. They were once afraid too, before they found the courage to try.

prompt.id: Cerita mana yang paling bikin kamu berani buat mulai explore?
prompt.en: Which story makes you feel brave enough to start exploring?

label.id: Seseorang yang awalnya takut tampil, tapi akhirnya berani nunjukin bakatnya.
label.en: Someone who was afraid to perform, but eventually found the courage to show their talent.

react.id: Kamu nggak sadar udah tepuk tangan paling kenceng.
react.en: You do not realise you are clapping the loudest.

label.id: Seseorang yang terus nyoba sampai akhirnya berhasil mewujudkan ide kreatifnya.
label.en: Someone who kept trying until they finally brought their creative idea to life.

react.id: Kamu catet satu kalimatnya di HP, buat dibaca lagi nanti.
react.en: You save one of their lines on your phone, to read again later.

label.id: Seseorang yang berani keluar dari comfort zone dan nyoba tantangan baru.
label.en: Someone who stepped out of their comfort zone and embraced a new challenge.

react.id: Kaki kamu udah pengin gerak sebelum ceritanya selesai.
react.en: Your feet want to move before the story even ends.

label.id: Seseorang yang mulai dari hal kecil sampai akhirnya bisa bawa perubahan.
label.en: Someone who started small and eventually made a meaningful difference.

react.id: Kamu kepikiran orang-orang yang bakal kamu ajak bareng.
react.en: You think of the people you would bring along.

beats.id: Sebuah pintu baru kebuka, ke sesuatu yang belum pernah kamu bayangin.
beats.en: A new door opens, to something you have never imagined before.

prompt.id: Mana yang paling bikin kamu penasaran, walaupun belum pernah dicoba?
prompt.en: Which experience makes you most curious, even if you have never tried it?

label.id: Menjelajahi dunia coding & AI
label.en: Exploring the world of coding & AI

react.id: Kamu ngetik baris pertama. Error. Kamu ketawa, terus coba lagi.
react.en: You type the first line. Error. You laugh and try again.

label.id: Mencoba olahraga yang bener-bener baru
label.en: Trying an entirely new sport

react.id: Gerakannya masih kaku, tapi napas kamu belum pernah selega ini.
react.en: The moves are still stiff, but you have never breathed this freely.

label.id: Menemukan hubungan antara kreativitas dan emosi
label.en: Discovering how creativity and emotions connect

react.id: Kamu nulis tiga kata tentang hari ini. Ternyata itu udah jadi sesuatu.
react.en: You write three words about today. Somehow, that is already something.

label.id: Mengubah ide sederhana jadi gerakan sosial
label.en: Turning a simple idea into a social movement

react.id: Satu orang ikut. Terus dua. Kamu nggak nyangka secepat itu.
react.en: One person joins. Then two. You did not expect it to be this fast.

beats.id: Setiap pilihan tadi bawa kamu ke sini. Siap liat ke mana eksplorasimu bakal pergi?
beats.en: Every choice you made brought you here. Ready to see where your exploration takes you?

label.id: Tampilkan Explorer Journey-ku
label.en: Reveal my Explorer Journey
